items.computation: The sender is a company, so there is no deemed delivery. The period runs from actual receipt, which is unknown. Earliest plausible start is the letter date, 19.04.2027. Three months end on 19.07.2027 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), a Monday and not a holiday in NW. If the letter arrived later, the deadline is later, e.g. receipt on 22.04.2027 gives 22.07.2027. Cancelling by 19.07.2027 is safe. The cancellation takes effect at the earliest on 01.06.2027.
